expense_ratio.answer: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund publishes its Total Expense Ratio (TER) monthly on the AMC site. The Regular plan TER varies with AUM slabs under SEBI limits; verify the latest figure on the official TER disclosure page before investing.

exit_load.answer: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund charges an exit load of 1% if units are redeemed within 365 days from the date of allotment. No exit load applies if redeemed after 365 days.

sip_minimum.answer: The minimum SIP installment for Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund is ₹99 per instalment, in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter.

lump_sum_minimum.answer: The minimum lump sum investment for Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund is ₹5,000, in multiples of ₹1 thereafter. Minimum additional purchase is ₹1,000.

benchmark.answer: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund is benchmarked against NIFTY 100 (Total Return Index).

riskometer.answer: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund carries a Very High risk profile as per the AMC riskometer classification for this equity scheme.

sip_frequency.answer: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund supports SIP facilities including monthly and quarterly frequencies, along with other systematic facilities such as SWP, STP, and switch as per the AMC offer document.

exit_load.answer: Mirae Asset Flexi Cap Fund charges an exit load of 1% if redeemed within 365 days from the date of allotment. No exit load applies after 365 days.

sip_minimum.answer: The minimum SIP installment for Mirae Asset Flexi Cap Fund is ₹99 per instalment, in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter.

lump_sum_minimum.answer: The minimum lump sum investment for Mirae Asset Flexi Cap Fund is ₹5,000, in multiples of ₹1 thereafter. Minimum additional purchase is ₹1,000.

benchmark.answer: Mirae Asset Flexi Cap Fund is benchmarked against Nifty 500 Index (Total Return Index).

riskometer.answer: Mirae Asset Flexi Cap Fund carries a Very High risk profile as per the AMC riskometer for this flexi cap equity scheme.

sip_minimum.answer: The minimum investment for Mirae Asset ELSS Tax Saver Fund is ₹99, with subsequent investments in multiples of ₹500 as per the scheme page.

lump_sum_minimum.answer: The minimum lump sum for Mirae Asset ELSS Tax Saver Fund starts at ₹99, with additional applications in multiples of ₹500 thereafter.

sip_frequency.answer: Mirae Asset ELSS Tax Saver Fund offers SIP and other systematic facilities (SWP, STP) as per the AMC scheme documents. Each SIP instalment is subject to the 3-year ELSS lock-in.

elss_lockin.answer: Mirae Asset ELSS Tax Saver Fund has a mandatory lock-in period of 3 years from the date of each investment instalment as mandated by SEBI for all ELSS funds.

statement_download.answer: You can download your Mirae Asset capital gains statement by visiting CAMS at camsonline.com or KFintech at kfintech.com. Log in, go to Statements, select Capital Gains, choose your financial year, and download the PDF.

elss_lockin.answer: All ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) funds have a mandatory lock-in period of 3 years from the date of each SIP instalment as per SEBI regulations. Redemption before 3 years is not permitted.

what_is_sip.answer: A SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) allows you to invest a fixed amount in a mutual fund at regular intervals — monthly, weekly, or quarterly. It helps build wealth gradually without needing a large lump sum upfront.

what_is_expense_ratio.answer: The expense ratio is the annual fee charged by a mutual fund to manage your investment. It is expressed as a percentage of your total investment. A lower expense ratio means more of your money stays invested.

what_is_exit_load.answer: Exit load is a fee charged when you redeem your mutual fund units before a specified period. It is meant to discourage early withdrawal. After the exit load period ends, redemption is free of charge.

what_is_nav.answer: NAV (Net Asset Value) is the per-unit price of a mutual fund scheme. It is calculated at the end of every business day. When you invest, units are allotted based on the applicable NAV.

what_is_elss.answer: ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) is a type of mutual fund that invests primarily in equities and qualifies for tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act up to ₹1.5 lakh per year. It has a mandatory 3-year lock-in period.
